meaning: Metadata for binding two RFC6902 patches; not a workload and not an admission receipt.

semantic_delta_sentences: Treat each supplied boundary as an optional hypothesis: use its activation, exclusions and limitations together, rather than treating retrieval order or a copied definition as evidence that the user requested it.

For each proposed intent, check the operation, its object and any direction or requested state against the original audio; a reason that only says the intent does not apply does not support listing it.

When that comparison leaves a genuine ambiguity, preserve the supported neighboring interpretation within the existing three distinct candidates and record the missing discriminating cue in unresolved_fields; do not pad with repeated intents or generic alternatives.

Keep each distinction focused on the cue that separates the candidates, not a transcript or a restatement of a card; do not resolve ambiguity by inventing unheard words or by changing label definitions.

The intent bindings on a slot card describe a possible semantic role, not a required field or proof that its value was spoken; extract a value only when the original audio expresses that role for the current candidate.

For a type that names a person, work, playlist or place, distinguish an actual spoken referent from a generic category word, a request for an unknown name, or a type identifier; never use a label or a card heading as a substitute for the spoken value.

Apply the supplied extraction and missing-behavior cues to the whole phrase: do not turn a request verb, a bare category or a vague modifier into a more specific value merely because that type is legal or appears under another candidate.

Preserve every supported mention, including ordinary words that really express a date, time, relation, mode or description; do not require a proper name or discard a real value because its intent binding is rare or absent.

An alternative candidate is a condition for interpreting the same audio, not an extra fact or a request to fill its usual slots; when no value is supported keep that candidate row with entities: [], and record unresolved uncertainty without manufacturing a filler.

application: After a complete coverage parent is selected and pinned, apply exactly one matching instruction patch to a copy of that full saea-intent-slot-workload-v1 object; preserve effective thinking/decoding and all other scientific fields. Give the new run a separate identity during standard staging. Never load this binding metadata or the patch array as a workload.
